known_limitations: This release publishes only the ten 2024 annual LFS major-group employment estimates. It does not publish wages, OFW distribution, O*NET Job Zone or generative-AI task exposure.

The PSOC 2012 code list was entered from classification documentation rather than the PSA volume. Every classification row is marked unverified_pending_source. The official PSOC API is identified but requires a token; it must be imported and diffed before detailed use.

The canonical table holds PSOC major and sub-major groups only. Minor and unit groups are absent rather than guessed, so occupation-level metrics (wages, O*NET Job Zone, task exposure) have no unit to attach to yet.
O*NET 31.0 is retrieved and hash-verified, but no O*NET-derived value is published because no accepted PSOC-to-O*NET correspondence exists.

The exact SOF 2024 occupation table is identified, but its XLSX is blocked by the publisher's CDN in automated retrieval. The current OWS tables do not satisfy the defined coded-occupation basic-pay metric.
No generative-AI task exposure score is published. The scoring harness still requires a reviewed PSOC-to-O*NET mapping and a completed model run.
The v1 exposure scores are not carried forward and are not a fallback.
This experimental exposure score has not yet undergone independent labour-economist validation.
No component of this release has been reviewed by a Philippine labour statistician.

disclaimers.exposure: Generative-AI task exposure indicates how much an occupation's tasks may be affected or assisted by generative AI. It is not an estimate of automation, displacement, layoffs, or future employment.
disclaimers.classification_verification: The PSOC 2012 code list in this release was entered from classification documentation, not from the token-gated official PSA API. Every classification row is marked unverified_pending_source.

directly_observed.label: Directly observed
directly_observed.explanation: A complete enumeration or administrative record of the population concerned — every unit counted, not a sample. Census and register counts qualify; sample surveys do not.

calculated.label: Calculated
calculated.explanation: Arithmetic we performed on published figures — a share, a rate, a sum. The calculation is ours and is documented; it inherits the uncertainty of its inputs.

estimated.label: Estimated
estimated.explanation: Produced from a sample and generalised to a population, so it carries sampling error. Reported with an interval wherever the source publishes one. Most official labour statistics are of this kind.

proxy_derived.label: Proxy-derived
proxy_derived.explanation: Measured on a different population, place or unit than the one shown, and carried across by a documented mapping. An indication, not a measurement of this occupation in the Philippines.

model_derived.label: Model-derived
model_derived.explanation: Produced by a model following a published rubric. A research signal, not an observation.

ph_official_statistical_authority.label: Philippine official statistical authority
ph_official_statistical_authority.explanation: The Philippine Statistics Authority or another body designated to produce official Philippine statistics.

ph_government_other.label: Other Philippine government source
ph_government_other.explanation: A Philippine government body publishing administrative or programme data that is not an official statistical series.

international_official_occupational.label: International official occupational source
international_official_occupational.explanation: An official occupational database maintained by a government outside the Philippines, or by an international organisation.

industry_administrative.label: Industry or administrative source
industry_administrative.explanation: An industry association or private administrative dataset.

project_generated.label: Project-generated research output
project_generated.explanation: Produced by this project. Not an external source, and not independent of the project's own assumptions.

confidence_grade_legend.A: Official source, matching granularity, sampling error published.
confidence_grade_legend.B: Official source, matching granularity, uncertainty not published.
confidence_grade_legend.C: Official source, but published coarser than displayed, or a non-trivial transformation stands between source and display.
confidence_grade_legend.D: Non-official or proxy source, or a source we have specified but not yet retrieved and verified.

availability_legend.published: A value is available and shown.
availability_legend.blocked_pending_source: The metric is defined and its source is identified, but that source has not been retrieved, so there is no value to show.
availability_legend.suppressed_low_sample: Withheld because the sample behind it is too small to publish.
availability_legend.not_applicable: This metric does not apply to this occupation.
availability_legend.withdrawn_unsupported: Published in a previous version and withdrawn because no evidence supported it.

employment_count.name: Employed persons
employment_count.definition: Number of employed persons whose primary occupation falls in this PSOC group, from the PSA Labor Force Survey.
employment_count.common_misreading: Not the number of jobs, and not additive with any finer occupation list drawn from a different classification.

wage_basic_pay.name: Average monthly basic pay, OWS establishments
wage_basic_pay.definition: Average monthly basic pay of time-rated workers on full-time basis in establishments covered by the PSA Occupational Wages Survey.
wage_basic_pay.common_misreading: Not the average earnings of all Filipino workers in the occupation. OWS covers non-agricultural establishments above an employment threshold and excludes informal and own-account workers.

ofw_distribution_share.name: Distribution of OFWs by major occupation group
ofw_distribution_share.definition: Of all overseas Filipino workers counted by the PSA Survey on Overseas Filipinos, the proportion whose occupation abroad falls in this major group. The denominator is all OFWs.
ofw_distribution_share.common_misreading: This is P(occupation | OFW). It is NOT the share of workers in an occupation who are OFWs, P(OFW | occupation) — that needs domestic employment in the same occupation as its denominator and a compatible universe. The two are not interchangeable.

onet_job_zone.name: O*NET Job Zone (US)
onet_job_zone.definition: O*NET's five-level summary of the preparation a US occupation typically requires.
onet_job_zone.common_misreading: Describes United States entry requirements. It is a proxy for the Philippine occupation only to the extent the crosswalk holds.

gen_ai_task_exposure.name: Generative-AI technical task exposure
gen_ai_task_exposure.definition: How much of the task content associated with an occupation current or plausibly near-term generative-AI systems could assist with or perform, under the published rubric.
gen_ai_task_exposure.common_misreading: Not automation probability, replacement probability, displacement, job loss, or any forecast of employment change.
